purpose: Import generated art into a local review queue, attach it to the correct entity/prompt, then export governed metadata for repository registration.
storagePolicy: GitHub Pages cannot write repository files directly. The Dev Platform saves an operator-local import queue in browser storage and exports JSON records for data/artworks.json.
matchingRules: Prefer promptId from selected prompt card
Entity ID must match a known prompt entity or deity/faction/map record when possible
File extension must be PNG, JPG, JPEG, or WEBP
Generated metadata must use a safe art folder
